purpose.zh: 练前臂屈伸肌，增强握力和手腕力量
purpose.en: Build the forearm muscles for stronger grip and wrists.

text.zh: 前臂平放在大腿上，只动手腕
text.en: Rest your forearm on your thigh and move only your wrist

text.zh: 手腕向上卷起，再慢慢放下过中立位
text.en: Curl your wrist up, then lower slowly past neutral.
Lift for one second and lower for three, through the full range.

commonErrors.zh: 用前臂抬起代替手腕屈伸
commonErrors.en: Lifting the forearm instead of bending the wrist.

cautions.zh: 用轻重量，手腕不适时减小幅度
cautions.en: Use a light weight and reduce the range if your wrist feels uncomfortable.
